question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sources"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"sources"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Sources means any thing or place from which something arises or originates.
 
• In the above sentence, the various **'sources' **by which the noise comes has been discussed.
 
• Thus,*** option 3)*** is the correct alternative.
